diagnosticPrinciples.zeroByte500: HTTP 500 with a 0-byte body is not a parameter-validation rejection (which produces a 4xx with a body). It may be an origin crash before serialization OR a Cloudflare edge drop — use cfRay + WAF logs to disambiguate.
diagnosticPrinciples.prefixIdenticalVsDivergent: When both /cloud/api/Manager and /cloud/api/Report return 500 (0 B), prefix routing is ruled out (prefix-identical: failure is in the shared handler/backend). When one prefix returns 500 and the other returns 200 (Pending, getGrading, getTransactions), the prefixes are distinct handlers (prefix-divergent).
diagnosticPrinciples.pointInTimeEvidence: Captures from 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-01 are dated observations, not claims about current live state. Re-probing with the identical captured payload separates deterministic crashes from transient failures.

pendingDeleteResolution.finding: In customer/report/report.js, setDeleteWager opens the 'Ticket Detail' modal for a previously bought-out/deleted transaction row (data-action='get-delete-wager') and calls getPendingWagers({ deleteWagers: true, ticketNumber }). That sends POST api/Report/PendingDelete with { customerID: $.playerWeekly, ticketNumber: e.ticketNumber, operation: 'PendingDelete' }, logs 'View Pending Plays Selected', and renders e.Pending[] into the modal. Despite its name, PendingDelete is a read-only ticket-detail lookup, not a delete mutation.
